DECISION_RATIONALE: ForecastBundle.metadata Dict[str, Any] technically survives JSON serialization and can store auxiliary key-values without changing frozen Schema v1.0 positional fields. However, codebase inspection confirms that metadata is currently used exclusively for descriptive provenance strings (model_id, status) and perturbation diagnostics. No governed pattern exists in POLARIS for transporting primary 24-hour time-series forecast arrays in metadata, and metadata values bypass ForecastBundle schema validation (TimeseriesForecast array length, non-negativity, and unit enforcement). Therefore, while metadata transport is technically feasible (Option B), using it for standalone wind speed requires an explicit governance definition (Decision B2) specifying key naming, array structure, units (m/s), and validation rules before implementation could be considered.
